concerns.text: FR-002 explicitly mandates a 'post-run checksum of rule-evaluation counters' to verify exact parity. T022 implements real-time enforcement, and T041 generates a 'report' aggregating logs. Neither task implements the specific checksum calculation (hashing the total count) required by the spec. A log report is not a checksum; this is a semantic weakening of the verification requirement.

FR-005 and US-3 require measuring 'initial single-task performance' before multi-task training. T026 depends only on the *code* of agents (T018-T020) being complete, not the *execution* of single-task runs. There is no task defined to execute the single-task training phases and persist the 'initial' metrics. Without this execution task, the 'initial' data required for the forgetting rate calculation cannot exist, violating the acceptance criteria.

SC-003 requires measuring retention 'to isolate the effect of bidirectional exchange' by comparing Co-evolving against a baseline where *no* exchange occurs. The tasks only compare Co-evolving vs. Mixed-task. There is no task to calculate or report the retention rate of the 'Sequential' condition (the true 'no exchange' baseline) against Co-evolving, failing to satisfy the isolation requirement of SC-003.

FR-002 and SC-002 imply that exact parity is a hard requirement for experiment validity. T041 and T048 generate reports but lack a task to implement a 'validation gate' that fails the build if the parity report shows deviation. A passive report does not satisfy the 'hard integer cap' and 'verified by post-run checksum' constraints if the system does not actively reject non-compliant runs.

T042 (Pilot Power Estimation) requires a full training run to estimate variance, but it depends on T028 (Warmup/Feasibility) which is in Phase 5. T028 depends on T023 (Training Loop) which depends on T028. This creates a circular dependency preventing the power analysis (SC-004) from running before the feasibility check, violating the logical flow required to determine N≥30.
